### 1. Purpose and boundaries

1.2 {{PUMP}} does not control {{SRC}}, {{DST}}, or valve line-up. *[Delete if a valve module owns line-up; otherwise add a line-up permissive in section 6.]*

**3.1 Modes**
| Mode | Who owns start, stop, speed |
|---|---|
| Auto | {{commander}} |
| Manual | Operator, from the faceplate |
| OOS | Nobody. The run command stays off. |

3.2 Change mode only when the state is Stopped or Tripped. Reject all other mode changes.

**3.3 States**
| State | Meaning | Entry permissives | Allowed exits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stopped | Run command off | Stop confirmed, or trip reset | Starting |
| Starting | Start sequence active | Start command, all start permissives true | Running, Tripped |
| Running | Pump at commanded speed | Start sequence complete | Stopping, Tripped |
| Stopping | Stop sequence active | Stop command | Stopped, Tripped |
| Tripped | Latched fault, run command off | Any trip condition | Stopped (by reset) |

**3.4 Transitions**
| ID | From → To | Trigger | Initiator | Automation level |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-{{MOD}}-001 | Stopped → Starting | Start command and permissives true | {{commander}} / operator | {{level}} |
| FR-{{MOD}}-002 | Starting → Running | Start sequence step {{n}} complete | Automatic | Automatic |
| FR-{{MOD}}-003 | Starting → Tripped | Start step timeout, permissive lost, or trip | Automatic | Automatic |
| FR-{{MOD}}-004 | Running → Stopping | Stop command | {{commander}} / operator | {{level}} |
| FR-{{MOD}}-005 | Running → Tripped | Interlock, VFD fault, run feedback lost | Automatic | Automatic |
| FR-{{MOD}}-006 | Stopping → Stopped | Run feedback off | Automatic | Automatic |
| FR-{{MOD}}-007 | Stopping → Tripped | Stop step timeout, or trip | Automatic | Automatic |
| FR-{{MOD}}-008 | Tripped → Stopped | Operator reset, all trip causes clear | Operator | Manual |

### 4. Regulatory control
| ID | Requirement |
|---|---|
| FR-{{MOD}}-009 | PV: {{none / PT}}. Output: VFD speed reference. Action: {{open loop / PID}}. |
| FR-{{MOD}}-010 | Clamp the speed reference to the limits in {{list item}}. Ramp it at the rates in {{list item}}. |
| FR-{{MOD}}-011 | In Auto, {{commander}} sets the speed. In Manual, the operator sets the speed. |

### 5. Sequences
**5.1 Start sequence**
| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check start permissives | All permissives true | Not applicable (one scan) | Refuse start. Tell the commander why. |
| 2 | Command VFD run at start speed {{list item}} | Run feedback true | {{timer}} | Stop. Go to Tripped. Raise start-fail alarm. |
| 3 | Prove discharge pressure *[optional]* | {{PT}} above {{list item}} | {{timer}} | Stop. Go to Tripped. Raise no-pressure alarm. |
| 4 | Release speed reference through ramp | Speed feedback within {{list item}} of reference | {{timer}} | Raise deviation alarm. Go to Running. |

**5.2 Stop sequence**
| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Ramp speed to stop speed {{list item}} | Speed feedback at or below stop speed | {{timer}} | Raise alarm. Go to step 2. |
| 2 | Remove run command | Run feedback false | {{timer}} | Go to Tripped. Raise stop-fail alarm. |

5.3 An interlock stop skips the ramp. It removes the run command at once.

# Part 2: Filled example, P-1102

## P-1102 Control Narrative (VFD Pump)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Doc no. / Rev / Date | CN-P1102 / A (draft) / 2026-10-18 |
| Module tag | P-1102 |
| Status | Draft |
| Reviewers and ops sign-off | Not yet assigned (OI-09) |

### 1. Purpose and boundaries
1.1 P-1102 moves product from mix tank T-110 to hold tank T-120.
1.2 P-1102 does not control T-110, T-120, or valve line-up.
1.3 The batch system sends the start request, stop request, and speed reference. The operator uses the faceplate in Manual.

### 2. Equipment and tags
| Role | Tag | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Pump | P-1102 | I/O list |
| VFD run command, run feedback, fault, speed feedback, speed reference | Per I/O list (OI-01) | I/O list |
| Suction low-level switch (T-110) | LSL-110 | I/O list |
| Discharge pressure | PT-1102 | I/O list |
| Destination high-level switch (T-120) | LSH-120 | I/O list |

### 3. Modes, states, and transitions
**3.1 Modes**
| Mode | Who owns start, stop, speed |
|---|---|
| Auto | Batch system |
| Manual | Operator, from the faceplate |
| OOS | Nobody. The run command stays off. |

3.2 Change mode only when the state is Stopped or Tripped. Reject all other mode changes.

**3.3 States**
| State | Meaning | Entry permissives | Allowed exits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stopped | Run command off | Stop confirmed, or trip reset | Starting |
| Starting | Start sequence active | Start command, all start permissives true | Running, Tripped |
| Running | Pump at commanded speed | Start sequence complete | Stopping, Tripped |
| Stopping | Stop sequence active | Stop command | Stopped, Tripped |
| Tripped | Latched fault, run command off | Any trip condition | Stopped (by reset) |

**3.4 Transitions**
| ID | From → To | Trigger | Initiator | Automation level | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-P1102-001 | Stopped → Starting | Start command and permissives true | Batch (Auto) / operator (Manual) | Automatic in Auto. Manual in Manual. | Sim |
| FR-P1102-002 | Starting → Running | Start step 4 complete | Automatic | Automatic | Obs |
| FR-P1102-003 | Starting → Tripped | Start step timeout, permissive lost, or trip | Automatic | Automatic | Sim |
| FR-P1102-004 | Running → Stopping | Stop command | Batch (Auto) / operator (Manual) | Automatic in Auto. Manual in Manual. | Obs |
| FR-P1102-005 | Running → Tripped | Interlock, VFD fault, run feedback lost | Automatic | Automatic | Sim |
| FR-P1102-006 | Stopping → Stopped | Run feedback off | Automatic | Automatic | Obs |
| FR-P1102-007 | Stopping → Tripped | Stop step timeout, or trip | Automatic | Automatic | Sim |
| FR-P1102-008 | Tripped → Stopped | Operator reset, all trip causes clear | Operator | Manual | Sim |

### 4. Regulatory control
| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-P1102-009 | P-1102 has no control loop. The speed reference is open loop. PT-1102 is for monitoring and start proof only. | Insp |
| FR-P1102-010 | Clamp the speed reference to the speed limits in the control parameter list. Ramp it at the ramp rates in the same list. | Sim |
| FR-P1102-011 | In Auto, the batch system sets the speed. In Manual, the operator sets the speed. Ignore the batch speed in Manual. | Sim |

### 5. Sequences
**5.1 Start sequence**
| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response | ID |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Check start permissives | All permissives true | Not applicable (one scan) | Refuse start. Tell the commander why. | FR-P1102-012 |
| 2 | Command VFD run at start speed (SP-P1102-01) | Run feedback true | TO-P1102-01 | Stop. Go to Tripped. Raise start-fail alarm. | FR-P1102-013 |
| 3 | Prove discharge pressure | PT-1102 above SP-P1102-02 | TO-P1102-02 | Stop. Go to Tripped. Raise no-pressure alarm. | FR-P1102-014 |
| 4 | Release speed reference through ramp | Speed feedback within SP-P1102-03 of reference | TO-P1102-03 | Raise deviation alarm. Go to Running. | FR-P1102-015 |

**5.2 Stop sequence**
| Step | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response | ID |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Ramp speed to stop speed (SP-P1102-04) | Speed feedback at or below stop speed | TO-P1102-04 | Raise alarm. Go to step 2. | FR-P1102-016 |
| 2 | Remove run command | Run feedback false | TO-P1102-05 | Go to Tripped. Raise stop-fail alarm. | FR-P1102-017 |

5.3 An interlock stop skips the ramp. It removes the run command at once. (Test: Sim)

### 6. Interlocks and permissives
| ID | Function | Effect | C&E ref | SIS? | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-P1102-018 | LSL-110 low, or bad quality | Block start. Trip when running. | C&E row per OI-02 | No (OI-03) | Sim |
| FR-P1102-019 | LSH-120 high, or bad quality | Block start. Trip when running. | C&E row per OI-02 | No (OI-03) | Sim |

Read the logic in the cause-and-effect chart. This document does not restate it. No SIS function is allocated to P-1102 here. The SRS owns any SIS function.

### 7. Alarms
Alarm IDs, priorities, and limits are in the alarm database. Filter by module P-1102. These events need an entry: start fail, no pressure, stop fail, VFD fault, LSL-110 trip, LSH-120 trip, speed deviation, batch comms loss, PT-1102 bad PV. (Test: Insp)

---

## Notes on my choices

- **Standards fit:** The state table follows ISA-106 style. ISA-106 covers continuous processes. If your batch system follows ISA-88, check that the batch phase interface matches the Auto mode here.
- **Control parameter list:** You said tags, ranges, and alarm setpoints already have homes. Start speed, ramps, deviation band, and timers probably do not. I assumed a "control parameter list" tab. Add one, or point those IDs at an existing list.
- **Defaults I picked:** Interlock trips latch and need an operator reset. Auto-restart after power loss is off. Mode changes are allowed only in Stopped or Tripped. These are in the open items for operations to confirm.
- **Template reuse:** Sections 3, 5, and 8 are mostly fixed text. Engineers only change the tags, list IDs, and optional rows.
